subjects.label: 顔・髪・服の質感
subjects.prompt: A realistic photographic portrait of a 30-year-old Japanese woman, head and shoulders, facing the camera, warm brown eyes with clear catchlights, shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair with loose strands, natural skin texture and a few light freckles, a relaxed gentle smile, small blue enamel earrings, wearing a cream cable-knit sweater. Soft natural window light from the left, a softly blurred green garden in the background, realistic colors, unretouched photography. The face fills a large part of the frame.

subjects.label: 人物・手・持ち物・服
subjects.prompt: A realistic photographic waist-up portrait of a 35-year-old Japanese man seated at a wooden cafe table, short slightly wavy black hair, warm brown eyes, natural skin texture, looking at the camera with a relaxed expression. Wearing a textured navy blue cardigan over a light gray shirt. His right hand holds the handle of a red ceramic mug on the table, and his left hand rests flat on the table with relaxed fingers. Both hands are fully visible. Soft natural window light from the left, a softly blurred cafe interior, realistic colors, candid editorial photography.
